newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures back off after heady gains.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures back off after heady gains.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures backed down on Wednesday as players cashed in some gains and re-evaluated outlooks after the market's unexpected surge the previous day.
Dealers said the Dow's flat overnight finish after two days of record closes also gave players room to pause for breath.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished at 21,200 against its previous settlment at 21,360 on light volume of 13,195 contracts.
"The market was dominated by dealers taking profit today. They were afraid it had gone up too far, too fast," said a dealer with a Japanese institution.
He said Tokyo stocks would be underpinned by continued bullish sentiment on the Dow.
The December Nikkei should be supported initially at 21,150 and then at 20,900, with resistance seen at 21,440.
"We might see another down day tomorrow. It could go down to 20,900 to cover the gap," he said, adding that the December Nikkei should eventually head towards a target of 21,750.
